text:
marie: quick check — where are we on the pricing/packaging migration deps? specifically metering adapter + quota contract changes. need milestone alignment by EOD.

dan: infra: can confirm runtime changes done for v2 meter schema, but adapter integration still needs one CR and an infra flag. targeting next Tues for the CR merge.

kevin: billing: we need quota shape clarified before we can ship. contract team requires hard limits on per-customer seat-level quotas (not just token-rate). got a sample payload from legal. cc @sam

sam: legal: we can accept seat-level limits but contract language needs to call out migration window and fallback behavior. please share the exact quota keys we plan to expose.

lucy: eng-infra: @dan can you paste the adapter config we plan to roll? i want to verify feature flag names for the dedicated fleet.

dan: paste below — this will be behind flag pricing_adapter_v2 and a canary route:
```
{
  "adapter_version": "v2",
  "quota_keys": ["seat_limit","monthly_quota_tokens"],
  "canary_route": "/pricing/v2-canary"
}
```

kevin: OK seat_limit + monthly_quota_tokens works for billing semantics. one ask: when we do the canary, billing needs a mapping table for legacy->v2 ids. who's owning that?

marie: action: @dan owns the mapping table + CR. @kevin will validate billing reports. @lucy will add flag rollout plan to console. @tessa please confirm SRE runbook for fallback.

tessa: noted — SRE: will add a rollback playbook. question: what are the SLA targets for canary? we should set alert thresholds for token error rate + throttle rate.

kevin: billing SLA targets: error rate <0.5% and invoice reconciliation match rate >99.9% across canary customers. i'll add checks to the billing smoke job.

dan: CR up by EOD today for the mapping table. will tag @lucy for review. canary rollout plan: small cohort (5 customers) on Wed, broader (50 customers) next Mon.

sam: legal: i'll prepare an amendment clause for the migration window and fallback, send draft by tomorrow lunch.

lucy: console note: I'll wire feature flag controls and a rollout slider. ETA Thu.

marie: good — can everyone drop final OKs in this thread when they have them. need a single owner to approve go/no-go on Tue morning. volunteering @dan unless someone objects.

kevin: fine by me, will sign off once mapping CR merged and billing smoke passes.

tessa: SRE OK pending runbook doc update, will post link when done.

deploy-bot: scheduled: pricing-adapter-v2-canary -> 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z (tentative). :rocket:

marie: thanks all. hrs: Dan (owner), Kevin (billing signoff), Lucy (console), Sam (legal), Tessa (SRE). please update status before Tue 09:00 PT. :eyes:
